{{Quote|One bit me, then at the smell of blood the others swarmed over me.|[[Bevel Lemelisk]]|<ref name="TEGtAS" />}}
'''Piranha beetles''' were [[Color/Legends|colorfully]]-shelled [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that lived on the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Though they were only three [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long, they gathered in large swarms which could kill much larger prey, like [[Runyip/Legends|runyips]], by eating the flesh directly off living beings.

[[File:Piranha_beetle.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Piranha beetle.]]

Piranha beetle swarms built hives made from chewed vegetation and saliva in Yavin 4's [[Tree/Legends|treetops]]. Each hive had a queen that led the hive's reproductive and food-gathering activities.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

Following the [[duel on Yavin 4]] between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] to the moon to acquire some of the beetles for him.<ref name="RR">{{InsiderCite|92|Refresher Reading}}</ref> [[Bevel Lemelisk]], one of the chief designers of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], was executed multiple times and then [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine. One of these executions involved piranha beetles. Lemelisk was placed in a mesh cage and swarms of piranha beetles were released through holes in the floor. The insects killed and devoured Lemelisk.<ref name="Darksaber" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] base on Yavin 4 was sprayed with chemical insecticide to keep the voracious insects out. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] established a [[Jedi Praxeum]] at the same location, he discovered that several of his students developed allergic reactions to the insecticides. He then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Aura of uneasiness|imprint the academy's perimeter with a sense of distaste and disorientation]]. This kept the beetle swarms away, but without the need for hazardous chemicals.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

When [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] attended the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4, he kept two piranha beetles as pets. He kept them calm by using the Force.

==Behind the scenes==
In the novel [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']], Palpatine says he rescued the beetles from Yavin 4 before the Death Star was supposed to destroy it, implying that they were collected shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In the "Refresher Reading" article in [[Star Wars Insider 92|''Star Wars Insider'' 92]], it was stated that Mas Amedda had also collected them after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era duel on Yavin 4 between Anakin Skywalker and Asajj Ventress.
